name: Git Control
description: A Git client inside Orca: commit graph, commits, branches, stashes and worktrees, plus GitHub and GitLab merge requests and pipelines, with your existing Git login. In a full tab and the right sidebar.

cover.alt: Git Control: a blue and lavender paper Git history sculpture with ivory commit nodes and revision cards on a dark studio backdrop
